content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Kansas City

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's secondary degree and experience thresholds—both matter. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications and clarify any gaps before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and master the PMBOK® Guide framework. This formal education satisfies PMI's required contact-hour prerequisite.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35-hour course, complete your official PMI application and pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the submission process and eligibility documentation. PMI reviews and approves your application before you schedule.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Sit for the four-hour, 180-question assessment on your timeline.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and resources to help you meet PMI's maintenance requirements and stay current in your field.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
